The number of relegation places from Division One are unchanged – they are occupied by 더비 카운티 , 사우스엔드 유나이티드 , and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 .

events.title: 1994 draws to a close with 블랙번 로버스 still top and now with a three-point lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드 as well as a game in hand. 리버풀 and 노팅엄 포리스트 are still in distant contention while a resurgent 토트넘 홋스퍼 are now putting pressure on the top five, while 리즈 유나이티드 and 맨체스터 시티's challenges are practically dead and buried as they have slid down the table considerably. 노리치 시티, meanwhile, finish 1994 in seventh place as manager John Deehan looks set to defy the critics who felt he could never successfully replace Mike Walker and mount a challenge for another European place. The month-end bottom four of 에버턴, 애스턴 빌라, 입스위치 타운 and 레스터 시티 remain unchanged from last month. 미들즈브러 continue to lead the Division One promotion race, now five points ahead of their nearest rivals 울버햄프턴 원더러스. 트랜미어 로버스, Reading and 셰필드 유나이티드 complete the top five, while the change of manager at 스윈던 타운 has made little difference to their league form (though they continue to progress well in the League Cup) as they are only outside the relegation zone on goal difference. The final Premier League games of 1994 include a 3–1 win for QPR against 아스널 at Highbury, 맨체스터 유나이티드 being held to a 2–2 draw at 사우샘프턴, leaders 블랙번 로버스 winning 1–0 at 크리스털 팰리스 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 climbing into sixth place with a 4–0 win at Coventry. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 keep up their Division One promotion push with a 3–1 win at 반즐리 , whose own promotion hopes are dented as a result. Leaders 미들즈브러 draw 1–1 at Stoke. 번리 climb out of the relegation zone with a 5–1 home win over Southend.

events.title: 에리크 캉토나's prison sentence is quashed on appeal and he is sentenced to 120 hours of community service . Meanwhile, his 맨체스터 유나이티드 side are still second in the league to a 블랙번 로버스 team who have a three-point lead and a game in hand. The threat from 리버풀, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 노팅엄 포리스트 is now even more distant to the point that it could be mathematically ended within a couple of weeks. At the other end of the table, 입스위치 타운 and 레스터 시티 continue to prop up the rest of the Premier League and will now need a practical miracle to beat the drop. Meanwhile, 크리스털 팰리스 are sinking deeper and deeper into hot water, while 사우샘프턴 have fallen into the bottom four. A first win of 1995 has helped ease 노리치 시티's worries as they stand 12th, but they are just six points ahead of 19th-placed 사우샘프턴 who have two games in hand. 아스널, still reeling from the 조지 그레이엄 and Paul Merson scandals, are suddenly under surprise threat of relegation from a division they traditionally compete at the top end of. 미들즈브러 have regained their lead of Division One, where 볼턴 원더러스, 트랜미어 로버스, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and Reading complete the top five.

events.title: The day after being confirmed as Football Conference champions, 매클즈필드 타운's celebrations are dashed in devastating fashion when the Football League announces that they will not be promoted into Division Three due to their Moss Rose ground not meeting safety requirements. While 체스터 시티 and 크루 알렉산드라 both offer the use of their respective Deva Stadium and Gresty Road grounds, the League refuse to waive their rule that new clubs must own their own ground (introduced to avoid a repeat of the situation which led to the demise of Maidstone United three years prior). This announcement also means that Scarborough and 엑서터 시티 , who had been battling to avoid bottom spot (with 노샘프턴 타운 also having been not entirely out of danger), are guaranteed safety regardless of where they finish. In the Autoglass Trophy final, a Wembley match is decided by a golden goal for the first time when a 103rd-minute goal from Paul Tait gives 버밍엄 시티 a 1–0 win over 칼라일 유나이티드 . Barry Fry 's team are also hoping to add the Division Two title – and with it an immediate return to Division One – to their first notable honour since they won the Football League Cup in 1963.
